Ā. ˚कते (pf. डुढौके [Pāṇ. vii, 4, 59, Kāś.] Hcar.; Bhaṭṭ.), to approach (with acc.), Kād.; Hcar.; Bhaṭṭ. : Caus. ढौकयति (aor. अडुढौकत्, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 2 and 59, Kāś.), to bring near (to gen.), cause to come near, offer, to any one (dat.), Kathās.; Rājat.; Bhaṭṭ.; KātyŚr., Sch.: Desid. डुढौकिषते, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 59 and viii, 4, 54, Kāś. : Intens. डोढौक्यते, vii, 4, 82, Vārtt. 1, Pat.; cf. उप.,
a: ढौक् — {c1c} A. (ढौकते, ढौकित) To go, approach; यांतं वने रात्रिचरी डुढौके Bk. 2. 23; 14. 71, 15. 49. --Caus. QuRQirAja ! ॥” tanmAhAtmyaM yaTA, -- “QuRQe ! praRamya puratastava pAdapadmaM yo mAM namasyati pumAniha kASivAsI । tatkarRamUlamaDigamya purAdiSAmi tatkiYcidatra na punarBavatAsti yena ॥” “yaH pratyahaM namati QuRQivinAyaka ! tvAM kASyAM prage pratihatAKilaviGnasaNGaH । no tasya jAtu jagatItalavartti vastu duzprApamatra paratra ca kiYca nApi ॥” “praTamaM QuRQirAjo'si mama dakziRato manAk । AQuRQya sarvvaBakteByaH sarvvArTAn saMprayacCasi ॥” tasya yAtrAviDAnaM yaTA, -- “mAGaSuklacaturTyAntu naktaM vrataparAyaRAH । ye tvAM QuRQe'rccayizyanti te'rccyAH syurasuradbizAm ॥ viDAya vArzikIM yAtrAM caturTIM prApya tApasIm । SuklAM SuklatilErbbadDAn prASnIyAllaqqukAn vratI ॥ kAryyA yAtrA prayatnena kzetrasidDimaBIpsuBiH । tasyAM caturTyAM tvatprItyE QuRQe ! sarvvopasargahft ॥ tAM yAtrAM nAtra yaH kuryyAnnivedya tilalaqqukAn । upasargasahasrEstu sa hantavyo ! mamAjYayA ॥ homaM tilAjyadravyeRa yaH karizyati BaktitaH । tasyAM caturTyAM mantrajYastasya mantraH prasetsyati ॥” iti kASIKaRqe । 50 aDyAye ॥

QuRQirAja!” tanmAhAtmyaM tatrEva yaTA “QuRQe praRamya puratastava pAdapadmaM yo mAM namasyati pumAniha kASivAsI । tatkarRamUlamaDigamya purA diSAmi tatkiYcidatra na punarBavatAsti yena । yaH prayahaM namati QuRQivinAyakaM tvAM kASyAM prage pratihatAKilaviGnasaMGaH । no tasya jAtu jagatItalavarttinastu duzprApamatra ca paratra ca kiYcanApi । praTamaM QuRQirAjo'si mama dakziRatomanAk । AQuRQya sarvaBakteByaH sarvArTAn saMprayacCasi” । tasya yAtrAviDAnamuktaM tatrEva yaTA “mAGaSuklacaturTyAntu naktavrataparAyaRAH । ye tvAM QuRQe'rcayizyanti te'rccyAH syurasuradvizAm । viDAya vArzikIM yAtrAM caturTIM prApya tApasIm । SuklAM SuklatilErbadDAn prASnIyAllaqaqukAn vratI । kAryyA yAtrA prayatnenaM kzetrasidDimaBIpsuBiH । tasyAM caturTyAM tvatprItyE QuRQe! sarvopasargahft । tAM yAtnAM nAtra yaH kuryyAnivedya tillaqqukAn । upavAsa sahasrantu sa hantAsmin mamAjYayA । homaM tilAjyadravyeRa yaH karizyati BaktitaH । tasyAM caturTyAM mantrajYastaTa mantraH prasetsyati” ।
